name: Sikafloor®-324
tagline: 2-PART PUR TOUGH-ELASTIC, LOW-VOC, SELF SMOOTHING FLOOR
summary: Sikafloor®-324 is a two part solvent free, pigmented with FP3 epoxy paste, self smoothing polyurethane resin, with tough-elastic properties. Sikafloor®-324 makes use of Sika's unique i-Cure technology to improve surface aesthetics and reduce sensitivity for ambient humidity during application.

packaging: Part A | 20.25 kg containers Part B | 4.75 kg containers Part A+B | 25.0 kg ready to mix units

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Synthetic resin screed material according to EN 13813:2002, certified by Factory Production Control Body and provided with the CE-marking
Coating for concrete protection according to EN 1504-2:2004, certified by Factory Production Control Body and provided with the CE-marking
Fire classification according to DIN EN 13501-1:2010-01: Report No. 20150909/01, MPA Dresden
Paint compatibility according to PV 3.10.7 tested at HQM Induserv Germany, test report 15-08-15203573-001.
Crack bridging properties following to EN 1062-7 method A, Test report No: 51-15-0056, IBOS GmbH.
Slip resistance class determined according to DIN 51131, test reports 020109-15-16, 020109-15-16a, 020109-15-17, 020109-15-17a, 020109-15-18, 020109-15-18a

items.label: Composition
items.text: Polyurethane (PUR)

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C.

items.label: Density
items.text:
Part A | ~1.4 kg/l
Part B | ~1.2 kg/l
Mixed resin (filled 1:0.5) | ~1.6 kg/l
Filling 1:0.5 with quartz sand F34 0.1–0.3 mm. All Density values at +23 °C.

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text: ~ 14 N/mm2 (14 days/23 °C/50 % r.h.) | (DIN EN ISO 527-2)

items.label: Tensile adhesion strength
items.text: >1.5 N/mm2 (failure in concrete) | (EN 13892-8)

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text: Resistant to many chemicals. Contact Sika technical service for specific information.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Part A : Part B = 81 : 19 (by weight)

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text:
Beware of condensation!
The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: < 4 % pbw moisture content. Test method: Sika®-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method.No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene-sheet).

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
Temperatures | Time
+10°C | ~ 40 minutes
+20°C | ~ 30 minutes
+30°C | ~ 20 minutes

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Before overcoating Sikafloor®-324 allow:
Substrate temperature | Minimum | Maximum
+10°C | ~ 30 hours | ~ 72 hours
+20°C | ~ 24 hours | ~ 48 hours
+30°C | ~ 16 hours | ~ 36 hours

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
Temperature | Foot traffic | Light traffic | Full Cure
+10°C | 1 day | 3 days | 9 days
+20°C | 12 hours | 2 days | 5 days
+30°C | 8 hours | 1 day | 3 days
Note: Times are approximate and will be affected by changing ambient conditions

items.label: Consumption
items.text: Please refer to the System Data Sheets

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Prior to mixing, stir part A mechanically. When all of part B has been added to part A mix continuously for 2 minutes until a uniform mix has been achieved. When parts A and B have been mixed, add the quartz sand F34 0.1–0.3 mm and mix for a further 2 minutes until a uniform mix has been achieved. To ensure thorough mixing pour the materials into another pail and mix again to achieve a consistent mix. After mixing leave the mixture for 3 minutes to react before applying.
Mixing Tools Sikafloor®-324 must be thoroughly mixed using a low speed electric stirrer (300 - 400 rpm) or other suitable equipment.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Prior to application, confirm substrate moisture content, relative humidity and dew point. Sikafloor®-324 is poured and spread evenly by means of a serrated trowel or pin rake. When used in a selfsmoothing system, roll in two directions with a spike roller to ensure even thickness and to remove entrapped air.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.

items.label: CLEANING
items.text: To maintain the appearance of the floor after application, Sikafloor®-324 must have all spillages removed immediately and be regularly cleaned using rotary brush, mechanical scrubbers, scrubber dryer, high pressure washer, wash and vacuum techniques etc., using suitable detergents and waxes.
